templates.name: Room entrance and exit
templates.description: Turn selected lights on for detected occupancy and off only after confirmed vacancy. Select an occupancy/presence sensor covering the occupied space.

templates.name: Room exit lights off
templates.description: Turn selected lights off after confirmed vacancy. This draft does not turn lights on and must be paused when manual lighting should remain unchanged.

templates.name: Bathroom entrance and exit
templates.description: Use a verified occupancy/presence sensor covering the shower and toilet. Motion-only sensing is deliberately excluded. Keep a manual-hold option and verify stationary occupants before enabling.

templates.name: Hallway motion lighting
templates.description: Turn selected hallway lights on when motion begins, then off after the selected no-motion delay. No motion is not proof that a stationary person has left a room.

templates.name: Bathroom ventilation
templates.description: Humidity hysteresis and a dry-out delay, with optional home-mode pause guards.

templates.name: Sunset curtains
templates.description: Close selected curtains at sunset, respecting optional pause modes.

templates.name: Dawat, Cinema and other home modes
templates.description: A persistent helper chooses exactly which entry/exit scenes to apply.
